import sys,json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,"/work/scripts")
import pytest,torch
from run_attention_diagnostic import checked_config
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
from irc_baseline_support import checked_packet
from run_irc_real_runtime import load_packet
from run_irc_prefill_probe import prefill_batch
assert not torch.cuda.is_available()
specs=json.loads("{\"a\":{\"path\":\"research/irc-eager-engine-config-v8.json\",\"sha256\":\"bccc5f0aa5e98fb1d1188cbc0053ab529fbdd9ecdfac42e892107f19f367af47\"},\"b\":{\"path\":\"research/irc-eager-engine-config-v8.json\",\"sha256\":\"bccc5f0aa5e98fb1d1188cbc0053ab529fbdd9ecdfac42e892107f19f367af47\"},\"c\":{\"path\":\"research/irc-eager-engine-config-v8.json\",\"sha256\":\"bccc5f0aa5e98fb1d1188cbc0053ab529fbdd9ecdfac42e892107f19f367af47\"}}")
configs={key:checked_config(Path("/work")/spec["path"],spec["sha256"],Path("/work")) for key,spec in specs.items()}
assert len(load_packet(configs["c"],Path("/work")))==16
rows=checked_packet(Path("/work"),configs["b"]["selection"],"selection")
batches=json.loads((Path("/work")/configs["b"]["input_inventory"]).read_text())["selection_batches"]
tokenizer=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(configs["b"]["model_path"],local_files_only=True,padding_side="left")
class ReachedFirstForward(Exception):
    pass
class Boundary(torch.nn.Module):
    device=torch.device("cpu")
    def forward(self,**kwargs):
        raise ReachedFirstForward()
model=Boundary().eval()
for batch in batches:
    try:
        prefill_batch(model,tokenizer,rows[batch["start"]:batch["start"]+8],configs["b"],batch)
    except ReachedFirstForward:
        continue
    raise AssertionError("missing CPU prefill boundary")
assert len(batches)==32
print(json.dumps({"event":"native_cpu_preflight","cuda_visible":False,"configs":len(configs),"source_files":len(configs["a"]["source_sha256"]),"runtime_files":len(configs["a"]["runtime_files_sha256"]),"version_count":len(configs["a"]["expected_versions"]),"fit_rows":16,"selection_batches_hash_checked":32}),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(pytest.main(["-q","tests/test_eager_mask_backend.py","tests/test_irc_eager_engine.py","tests/test_mask_diagnostic.py","tests/test_attention_diagnostic.py","tests/test_short_prefill_backend.py","tests/test_attention_backend.py","tests/test_irc_real_runtime.py","--tb=short","-o","cache_dir=/tmp/pytest-cache","--junitxml=/out/native-tests.xml"]))
